heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy through the north and a slight chance of flurries or drizzle in the north, clouds beginning to clear from the south. Lows in the 20s to low 30s, mid 30s around Lake Champlain. Light northwest wind.

heading: Monday
text: Increasing sun south to north, still partly cloudy north until the evening. Highs from the upper 30s to low 40s in the north, increasing into the mid to upper 40s in the south. West to northwest winds around 5 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Partly cloudy through the north and mountains, then skies clearing overnight. Mostly clear in southern valleys. Lows in the 20s.
